method: Compared all 73 repaired source/English pairs after removing only explicit fallback-marker caption ranges matched by MARKER_RE. Those ranges are not treated as discarded mathematics: all corresponding assets and routes were separately bound and the affected captions were visually reviewed.

Counted strong mathematical trigger characters, MATH_CHAR_MAP keys, Unicode mathematical symbols, mathematical-letter names, letterlike symbols, subscripts/superscripts, arrows, circled digits, primes, and the supported combining/precomposed mathematical accents.

Rendered caption-free source and English bodies and independently collected all balanced script arguments plus directed-arrow upper/lower labels. Normalized whitespace, Unicode minus, and roman label wrappers; preserved actual label contents and arrow directions.

Investigated every raw-symbol nonidentity against its surrounding source/English wording and the controlling formula/crop where applicable. No new mathematical assertion or missing formula was inferred solely from inventory equality.

nonidentity_dispositions.disposition: The two occurrences of source Δ_{-1} become Δ_{−1} in English. ASCII hyphen versus Unicode minus is the same negative index; no term is added.
The two occurrences of source Δ_{-1} become Δ_{−1} in English in the augmented-object definition. This is negative-index typography only.

The parenthetical definition '(D^+(X_•) = la catégorie ...)' is translated '(D^+(X_•) is the bounded-below derived category ...)'. The equality sign becomes defining prose; the category and bounded-below condition are retained.
Source 'L’application (φ_1)_2 est x ↦ (δ_0x, δ_1x, δ_2x)' becomes 'The map (φ_1)_2 sends x to (δ_0x, δ_1x, δ_2x)'. The same input, ordered output and map direction are explicit in prose.
One occurrence of 'morphismes de ℚ-structures de Hodge' is translated 'morphisms of rational Hodge structures'. The rational coefficient field is retained as its English adjective.
Two occurrences of 'isomorphisme de ℚ-structures de Hodge mixtes' are translated 'isomorphism of rational mixed Hodge structures'. Displayed ℚ coefficients remain unchanged.

Three source arrow-script markers correspond to English dash-label-arrow input (∂ twice and Res once); normalized canonical above-arrow labels are identical. ℋ and 𝓗 both serialize as mathcal H. R^ij_* correctly has the single-letter superscript i followed by j, agreeing with English R^i j_*.

Two source E_1 forms correspond to English E₁ and serialize identically. Source P^n and English ℙ^n both denote the explicitly identified projective spaces. The ev subscript is whole in both languages; roman versus italic label styling does not change its content.

Source →^{f^0} corresponds to the English dash-f^0-arrow input and yields the same complete above-arrow label. ℋ and 𝓗 are mathcal H aliases. Source P^n and English ℙ^n denote the same explicitly identified projective spaces. Braced versus unbraced an is serialized as the whole analytic label.

Source U_i =_{dfn} φ^{-1}(i) becomes U_i=φ^{-1}(i) in an English defining phrase. Only the redundant definition tag is omitted; the equality, variable and inverse-image operands remain. ℱ and 𝓕 both serialize as mathcal F.

Source defines the unique component by 'telle que s∈α_0(s)'; English says the unique irreducible component containing s. This accounts for the one extra source α, subscript 0 and membership sign. The map α_0:S→I and the component-selection condition are retained.

crop_border_review.method: Read-only raster screening counted dark pixels below grayscale 128 within each 10-pixel border; candidates exceeded 20 dark pixels on any side. Visually inspected candidates to distinguish scan streaks, footer marks, surrounding prose and overlapping crop boundaries from lost controlling mathematics.
crop_border_review.false_positive_disposition: P0066-A02 was rechecked against native authority page 67: the diagram begins at y=2750 and the inherited crop begins at y=2749, with no controlling ink in the checked preceding band. It remains the frozen presentation, with no override or disclosure.

cold_verification.render_inventory_hash_method: Per document: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON list of {path: page filename, sha256: uppercase hash}, sorted by filename, with sorted object keys and compact comma/colon separators.

scope_limit: PASS covers exact authority/input identity, repair replay, route binding, all-record cross-language notation comparison, native crop preservation, the stated visual coverage and final byte reproducibility. It is not a new mathematical proof of the inherited article or a claim that source-authorized ambiguities were silently emended.
